findings.issue: The answer's review says the allergic sister orders 'curries and dipping sauces included', while Brooke's peanut line in script[10] lists 'no dipping sauce'. In context Brooke clearly means peanut dipping sauce, and the review is meant to show the sauces are safe, so it is not a real contradiction. Still, a very literal player could read it as the answer serving the exact thing Brooke ruled out.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop the overlap: 'She's been ordering something different every week for a year, curries and all the sauces on the side, and has never had a single reaction.' (Alternatively 'curries and salads included'.)

findings.issue: Every other venue now has a detail that has nothing to do with the puzzle (Orchid Row's orchids and noon line, Teak Door's unmarked carved door, River Bell's river-view back room, Koi Counter's eight stools). Monsoon Alley, the trap, has only peanut and healthy evidence, so it is a little easier to pick out as the odd one out. Map-seeder v6 asks for at least one detail unrelated to the puzzle at every venue; 'smell it from the sidewalk' arguably counts, but it is tied to the satay.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a neutral detail to review 2, e.g. 'Grilled chicken, bright herb salads and a broth that tastes clean, nothing swimming in oil. The owner's playlist is all old love songs, which I've come to enjoy. A smart pick when you still have a 2pm meeting to stay awake through.' Avoid anything that hints at seating, noise or speed, since the venue has none of those tags.

summary: Re-review after the v5/v6 fixes. Seven of the eight earlier suggestions are fixed: (1) the peanut reviews no longer share a template, and River Bell has the level's only staff promise; (2) the craving now starts from Liam's dream instead of an office smell; (3) Maya no longer mentions pad thai, and pad see ew appears at Orchid Row, Teak Door and River Bell; (4) Brooke has new words (climbing, fried lunch, first hold); (5) the trip has no week count or month; (6) the Koi Counter outcome names only Cyrus and Maya; (7) Koi Counter says 'light lunch'. The eighth (resting Koi Counter in level_10) was advice for level_10 and is still open there. Nothing regressed. The story beat lands in three lines, and Cyrus never says 'peanut'. The peanut clue is still implied, carried by Liam's satay callback and Brooke's 'no satay, no dipping sauce, nothing crushed on top of the noodles'. Maya's $ budget is implied through the trip fund and 'more than a few bucks'. Brooke's healthy need is one clear wish. Every review evidences its venue's deciding attributes through experience. River Bell's 'farewell lunch' is a stranger's team lead and doesn't touch the friends' story, so it doesn't step on the level_20 send-off beat. Two small new polish points: a literal overlap between 'dipping sauces' and Brooke's line, and Monsoon Alley lacking a detail unrelated to the puzzle.
